text:
Alex K.: Heads up — product is targeting a staged global launch end of next month and PM flagged potential Black Friday overlap window. Need a quick capacity sanity check for GPU pool and cross-region fallbacks.
Maria P.: Do we have rough estimates from marketing on traffic multipliers?
Priya R.: Marketing expects a 2.8x baseline spike for launch day, and a 4.5x for Black Friday if both hit the same week. They say peak window ~3 hours.
Cheng L.: Current steady-state is ~600 rps with avg 25 tokens/request. That maps to ~15k tokens/sec. With current batching we handle ~2200 tokens/sec per A100-80GB equivalent.
Samir: Quick calc: if traffic 2.8x => ~1680 rps -> ~42k tokens/sec. That needs ~19 A100-eq concurrent for token throughput at current batching. For the 4.5x BF scenario that's ~31 A100-eq.
Alex K.: We should translate to GPU-hours. If we provision headroom for 50% over peak for safety and can autoscale: for 31 A100-eq peak -> reserve 46 GPUs for 3 hr peak => 138 GPU-hours plus padding for canaries and prewarm.
Maria P.: Cost check: at list rate that's ~ $x/hr per A100 (placeholder), so add finance to give exact. But ops: can we leverage cheaper spot pools or burst to other regions?
Cheng L.: Two constraints: 1) eu-west region has a quota cap of 32 A100-eq by default. 2) latency-sensitive users in NA can't be routed to APAC for low-latency served traffic. We can route non-low-latency traffic to EU or APAC if customers allow.
Priya R.: PMs will accept routing for low-tier customers, but enterprise customers must stay in-region. Expect ~20% of traffic to be enterprise.
Samir: So effective headroom needed in NA is ~80% of peak. If global peak 31 GPUs -> NA ~25 GPUs, plus 20% reserved for enterprise -> keep 30 in NA. Means we still need EU / APAC capacity for the remainder.
Alex K.: Action items: 1) Request quota increase in eu-west (from infra quota owners). 2) Plan temporary Dedicated burst capacity reservation for launch and BF window. 3) Add routing policy to prefer NA, fallback EU, then APAC for non-enterprise. 4) Prewarm KV caches 1 hour before launch to avoid initial cold penalty.
Cheng L.: I'll open the quota ticket now. Can we use dedicated reserved pools with lower quantized models for cheaper burst? That saves cost but we need QA on output quality.
Maria P.: Finance: if we push to spot/ephemeral we save ~45% but risk interruptions. For short 3hr peak that's acceptable if we have fallbacks. Add financial delta to the plan.
Samir: Also consider enabling aggressive batching on non-interactive endpoints for the launch window; reduces GPUs needed by ~18% based on last stress run. Need to whitelist endpoints that can tolerate latency.
Priya R.: Ops runbook note: schedule out routine infra maintenance at least 48 hours away from launch/BF.
Alex K.: Who can own the capacity reservation request and the routing policy change?
Cheng L.: I'll own the quota/region reservation ticket. Samir can own routing + batching toggles.
Samir: Ack. I'll draft the routing change and the list of endpoints to batch.
Maria P.: I'll coordinate with Finance to get exact cost numbers and clearance for the reserved spend.
Priya R.: I'll update PMs and the launch checklist, and make sure enterprise customers get notified about geo restrictions.
ops-bot: :information_source: Incident runbook reminder — confirm warmup tasks executed 60 minutes before any major launch.
Alex K.: Great — timeline: quota request + reserved capacity order by EOW, routing/batching config in staging by next Tue, full dress rehearsal 3 days before launch. If Black Friday overlap stays probable we do a second dress rehearsal.
Cheng L.: Link to quick calc sheet: <https://company-internal/spreadsheets/launch-gpu-forecast> (please don't break perms).
Samir: Example config snippet I'll test in staging:
```
routing_policy:
  - match: enterprise
    prefer_region: NA
    fallback: EU
  - match: default
    prefer_region: NA
    fallback: EU,APAC
batching:
  endpoints: [/summarize,/embed]
  max_delay_ms: 40
  target_tokens_per_batch: 4096
```
Alex K.: Perfect. TL;DR: we need to provision ~46 A100-eq for worst-case global+50% headroom for ~3 hours, split across regions given quotas, prefer reserved/dedicated pools with spot burst fallback, enable aggressive batching for non-interactive endpoints, and run two dress rehearsals if BF is concurrent. I'll post a short summary to #incidents and add to the launch doc. :thumbsup:
